idea-plugin.name: PHP Magic Method Navigation
idea-plugin.description:
Navigate PHP's invisible magic-method calls.

PHP invokes some methods implicitly: a (string) cast or an echo secretly calls __toString(); $callable(...) secretly calls __invoke(). None of these mention the method by name, so the IDE offers no jump to the code that actually runs. This plugin adds it.

  • A gutter icon at every implicit site — a (string) cast, an echo/print, string interpolation ("$obj"), concatenation ("x" . $obj), and dynamic invokes ($callable(...)) — jumping to the target method. Union types that can dispatch to several implementations open a multi-target popup.
  • Go to Declaration (Ctrl+Click / Ctrl+B) on the operand also offers the magic method, alongside the normal jump.
  • Correctly handles the \Stringable interface, nullable/union types (only the members that are actually callable are offered), and de-duplicates so nested and multi-argument sites never double-mark.

Configurable under Settings | Tools | PHP Magic Nav.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 0.1.0 — First release. Forward navigation to __toString() from casts, echo/print, interpolation and concatenation; navigation to __invoke() from dynamic $callable(...) calls; gutter markers + Go to Declaration; multi-target unions; settings toggles.
